name: Sign in with Apple
description: Sign in with Apple button, credential handling, session persistence in the Keychain and a revocation check on launch.

cost.note: Free to build and run in the simulator; the Sign in with Apple capability on a device and App Store distribution need an Apple Developer Program membership

amounts.label: Apple Developer Program membership (needed to distribute; not needed for simulator builds)

usage: Create one `AppleSignInModel(store: KeychainStore())` at the composition root and pass it down. Call `await model.restore()` in a `.task` at launch. Show `AppleSignInView(model:)` while `model.state` is `.signedOut` or `.failed`, and the app when it is `.signedIn(account)` (account.displayName and account.email may be nil after the first sign-in). Offer `model.signOut()` in Settings. Previews use `AppleSignInModel(store: InMemorySecureStore())`.
statusNote: Swift compiled on a Mac in the combined compile check (see compileCheck); the module's own verify run has not passed yet: `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify sign-in-with-apple` on a Mac with XcodeGen.

compileCheck.scope: Template Swift and the verify usage file compiled with every other module in one app target (scripts/capability-compile-check.mjs, clean build in Xcode). Not covered: the XcodeGen project, entitlements, the widget extension target and runtime behavior.
